documents.content: Oprel daemon exposes a high-performance local inference runtime. The server uses Unix domain sockets on Linux and macOS for zero-overhead local IPC, while falling back to HTTP localhost:11435 on Windows systems. State is persisted in SQLite at ~/.cache/oprel/models/chat_history.db with WAL mode enabled.

Oprel hybrid search uses ChromaDB for dense cosine embeddings and BM25Okapi for keyword matching. The candidate lists from both stores are fused using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) with constant k=60. Dense vector weight defaults to 0.7 while keyword weight defaults to 0.3.

Supermemory maintains persistent conversational context across daemon restarts. It isolates recent dialogue within a sliding window of 6 turns. Older conversational turns are indexed into a dedicated Chroma collection oprel_supermemory and SQLite table conversation_memories.

Oprel supports GGUF quantization formats including Q4_K_M, Q5_K_M, and Q8_0. On devices with limited Unified Memory or VRAM, Q4_K_M provides the optimal tradeoff between memory footprint and perplexity.
